title: Northgate Delivery & Installation Per-Mile Rate by Value of the Delivered Purchase
content:
On a Northgate Delivery & Installation appointment, the per-mile fee charged for road miles beyond the included radius follows the merchandise on the purchase being delivered, counted as the amounts of its sale lines less the amounts of its returned lines. Those lines are the purchase's own sale and return lines as kept under Northgate Purchases & Returns.

## Rate card

| Merchandise on the purchase being delivered (sale lines less returned lines) | Per-mile fee |
|---|---|
| $3000.00 or more | $0.90 a mile |
| $2000.00 or more but under $3000.00 | $1.10 a mile |
| Under $2000.00 | The service level's per-mile fee |

Only the purchase being delivered is counted: its sale-line amounts, less the amounts of the lines returned from it.

## Both sides of each threshold

| Merchandise | Per-mile fee |
|---|---|
| $3000.00 | $0.90 |
| $2999.99 | $1.10 |
| $2000.00 | $1.10 |
| $1999.99 | The service level's per-mile fee |

## Hypothetical purchases

- Sale lines of $3200.00 and a returned line of $400.00 leave $2800.00 of merchandise: $1.10 a mile.
- Sale lines of $3400.00 with nothing returned: $0.90 a mile.
- Sale lines of $2100.00 and a returned line of $150.00 leave $1950.00: the service level's per-mile fee.
